context: Checks the agent declines or downsizes challenges that the skill says not to run, and explains why.

checklist.name: Recognises the first target as trivial
checklist.description: The agent identifies the rename as low-stakes and easily reversed.

checklist.name: Does not spawn the deep sub-agent
checklist.description: The agent does not spawn the devil's advocate sub-agent for the rename.

checklist.name: Explains why deep is wrong here
checklist.description: The reply says all nine patterns on a minor decision waste effort and devalue the signal.

checklist.name: Offers a proportionate alternative
checklist.description: The reply suggests a quick comment or no challenge instead of the full protocol.

checklist.name: Recognises the second request as a repeat
checklist.description: The agent notes the same subcommand was already run on the same target.

checklist.name: Notes absence of new evidence
checklist.description: The reply states that no new evidence has emerged since the earlier run.

checklist.name: Does not silently rerun verify
checklist.description: The agent does not execute the verify protocol again without first raising the repeat.

checklist.name: Leaves a way to proceed
checklist.description: The reply says what new evidence would justify a rerun, or asks the requester to confirm.

checklist.name: Does not invent findings
checklist.description: No fabricated challenge findings are produced for either target.

checklist.name: Reply is concise
checklist.description: The explanation is short and proportionate to the stakes.
